common.notDiagnosis: A personal, longitudinal reading — not a diagnosis.

welcome.title: Take a moment. You're in a calm space
welcome.body: MindWeave helps you keep your days steady — gentle memory activities, the routines that matter, and a voice to walk you through them.
welcome.card2: Is it normal to feel tired even after resting?

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: This is used across the whole app, including everything read aloud.

profile.title: Who's here today?
profile.body: Choose a space. Nothing is locked, and you can switch at any time.

home.moodPromptFirst: Tell me how you feel today
home.whatNext: What would you like to do?
home.streak: {count} days in a row. That consistency is doing more than any single session.

mood.title: How are you feeling right now?
mood.replyHappy: That is lovely to hear. Let us keep the day gentle and steady.
mood.replyCalm: Calm is a good place to be. Nothing here is in a hurry.
mood.replyTired: Rest is allowed. Perhaps something short and easy today.
mood.replyAnxious: That feeling will pass. A slow breath together might help.
mood.replyUpset: Thank you for telling me. You do not have to carry it alone.

games.title: Activities
games.subtitle: Chosen to match how you have been doing
games.note: Difficulty moves on its own, based on your last few sessions. There is no score to chase and no way to fail.
games.matchBlurb: Turn the cards over and find the pairs. Nothing disappears if you are slow.
games.objectsBlurb: A handful of everyday objects appear, then you pick them out again.
games.sequenceBlurb: Shapes light up one by one. Repeat the order back, and it grows a little.

play.wellDoneBody: That sat comfortably above your usual pattern.
play.goodTryBody: Every attempt counts — this one is saved too.
play.playedAt: Played at {tier} · saved to your progress
play.matchSub: Take as long as you like — nothing is timed against you.
play.objectsRecallSub: Tap the ones you saw. Wrong taps are fine.
play.seqWatchSub: Just watch — your turn comes next.
play.seqTurnSub: Tap them back in the same order.
play.seqWrongSub: That broke the run, and that is completely fine.

voice.title: Shall I talk you through it?
voice.body: Pick a moment below and I'll read it aloud, slowly.
voice.label: Voice
voice.customPlaceholder: Type anything and I will read it out…
voice.unsupported: This device has no speech voice available, so the scripts are shown as text instead. They still work read on-screen.
voice.missingTitle: Voice for this language isn't installed
voice.missingBody: Your phone does not have a {language} voice yet. You can install it from Android's settings, or carry on and hear English instead.
voice.orientationBlurb: Grounds the day, the date and what comes next.
voice.orientationScript: Good morning {name}. Today is {date}. You are safe and you are at home. In a little while there will be breakfast, and then some gentle memory activities. There is nothing you need to worry about right now.
voice.hydrationBlurb: A gentle nudge toward a glass of water.
voice.hydrationScript: {name}, this is a gentle reminder to have some water. A full glass now will help you feel clearer and more comfortable. Take your time, there is no rush.
voice.medicationBlurb: Walks through taking the scheduled dose.
voice.medicationScript: {name}, it is time for your scheduled medication. Find your pill box, take the dose for this time of day, and drink a full glass of water with it. When you have finished, you can mark it as taken.
voice.encouragementBlurb: Explains the activity and takes the pressure off.
voice.encouragementScript: {name}, you are about to do a short memory activity. There is no score to worry about and no way to fail. Simply look, take your time, and choose what feels right. Every attempt helps.
voice.calmingBlurb: A guided breath for restless moments.
voice.calmingScript: Let us take a moment together. Breathe in slowly through your nose, two, three, four. Hold gently, two, three. And breathe out slowly through your mouth, two, three, four, five. Again. In, two, three, four. Hold. And out, slowly. You are doing beautifully. Let your shoulders drop, and rest here as long as you like.

progress.title: How you're doing
progress.body: Measured against your own pattern over time — never against anybody else.
progress.label: Progress
progress.empty: No sessions yet. Try one activity and the first reading will appear here.
progress.chartEmpty: Two or more sessions are needed before a trend can be drawn.

insight.tooFew: Not enough activity yet. A few more sessions will establish a personal baseline.
insight.early: Early days. Keep sessions short and regular to build a reliable baseline.
insight.down: Recent sessions are running below the usual personal pattern. Easier activities and a check-in may help.
insight.up: Recent sessions are running above the usual personal pattern. Gradually increasing challenge looks appropriate.
insight.steady: Performance is broadly consistent with the recent personal pattern.

reminders.title: Your routines
reminders.body: The shape of the day. Switch off anything that no longer fits.
reminders.note: Routines live on this device. Marking one done feeds the caretaker's adherence view for today.
